rules.description: Discard index hash and mode lines (e.g., 'index abc123..def456 100644')
Discard old file path headers ('--- a/file') — redundant with diff --git
Discard new file path headers ('+++ b/file') — redundant with diff --git
Discard hunk headers ('@@ -start,count +start,count @@') — keep only actual changes
